verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a workflow platform like Windmill, which stores job logs and results, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention periods, log or job-result purging, or deletion controls. Variable encryption, roles and permissions, scoped tokens and self-hosting are adjacent features and do not count as retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
